# Use any OAuth for the QR warning and all OAuth for password suppression

The QR account list records whether either server uses OAuth and whether both do. updateIntroState warns when any selected account uses OAuth, but hides and disables password export only when there is at least one selection and all selected accounts are OAuth-only. The empty-selection guard avoids every([]) making the password section disappear. Current code additionally honors the password-display restriction preference; do not attribute that later gate to 1029.

Scope: QR export selected-account aggregate logic.
